details: Bitcoin (BTC) experienced significant net inflows into its U.S. spot exchange-traded funds (ETFs), breaking a prolonged outflow streak. This resurgence, with inflows exceeding $220 million, was largely attributed to weaker-than-expected U.S. jobs data. The macroeconomic news fostered expectations of a more dovish stance from the Federal Reserve, boosting investor confidence in risk assets like Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Sees ETF Inflows Amid Weak US Jobs Report

details: Despite some institutional players like SharpLink accumulating significant amounts of Ethereum (ETH) and a prominent forecaster predicting a potential surge to $95,000 post-crash, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have continued to see substantial capital outflows. June 2026 recorded over $529 million in net outflows, with a $1.61 million outflow from Fidelity's Ethereum Fund on July 2, indicating weak institutional conviction in the near term.
title: Ethereum Faces ETF Outflows Despite Institutional Accumulation

details: Europe's Markets in Crypto Assets (MiCA) regulation has introduced stricter requirements for exchanges, brokers, custodians, and stablecoin issuers. This has led to significant shifts, including Binance reportedly withdrawing its MiCA application and Revolut delisting Tether's USDT in Europe. The MiCA regime is currently under review, with a consultation period extending until approximately September 2026.
title: MiCA Regulation Impacts European Crypto Market

details: XRP has extended its 7-day gains, with its price rising to $1.18, marking an 11% increase. This rally is attributed to Ripple's expanding footprint in cross-border payments and the XRP Ledger nearing 1 million AI-agent transactions, fostering fundamental optimism and increased institutional demand.
title: XRP Records Significant 7-Day Gains, Reaching $1.18

details: Visa has partnered with M-Pesa to launch a stablecoin-powered cross-border transfer pilot in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). This initiative combines traditional payment rails with stablecoin technology to test efficient cross-border transfers.
title: Visa Launches Stablecoin Pilot with M-Pesa in DRC
